title: spec(connector docblocks): "refused by name, located at the key" — zod locates unrecognized_keys at the entry root
body:
domain:spec#1 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmPi25XXKx92Xmg4viS

Filing gate: ① a defect with a named location: a published `@objectstack/spec` docblock (spec ships `src/**/*.zod.ts`) states a location the code does not give. Raised as a should-fix by the contract review of PR #28815 (record 6564332762, ④ Findings). ⛔ Not a claim. No grade: triage sets it.
Reader: `domain:spec`, prose only in `packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts`.
Dedupe (open AND closed): "located at the key" connector → none.
reach: authors and agents who read the `defineConnector` / `DeclarativeConnectorEntryBaseSchema` docblocks and look for the error at the key's path.

## Where

`packages/spec/src/integration/connector.zod.ts`: the `defineConnector` docblock added by PR #28815 ("refused by name, located at the key") and the `DeclarativeConnectorEntryBaseSchema` docblock it inherits the phrase from (#28688).

## What the code does

`strictObject` refuses with one zod `unrecognized_keys` issue at the containing object (path `[]`, the entry root) and names the key in `keys`. PR #28815's own test pins path `''`.

## Done when

Both docblocks say the refusal is at the entry root and names the key in `keys`. No behaviour change; spec patch changeset.
